recipe.visualDefinition: A vintage-style music single cover featuring a large, 3D-effect title at the top, a central monochrome band photograph, and a circular promotional badge on the right, all set against a clean white background with centered sans-serif text.
coreVisualRelationships: Large-scale title dominates the top third of the composition.
Monochrome rectangular photograph anchored at the bottom center.
Circular badge provides a geometric and color contrast to the right of the text.
Information hierarchy flows from top (Artist) to middle (Track) to bottom (Image).
coreInvariants: Heavy drop-shadow on the main title
Circular red badge with white internal text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The band photograph is centered at the bottom, occupying roughly 40% of the vertical space. The title spans the full width of the top margin.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, light-blue 3D title at the top acts as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large title, move down through the track listing, and rest on the group photograph at the base.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space around the central text block and between the badge and the main title.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-contrast black and white photography paired with flat, saturated primary/secondary colors for graphic elements.

letterConstructionRules: Hard-edged 3D extrusion on the main title
characterSpecificRedesigns: Title letters feature a deep, solid-color drop shadow to create a blocky 3D effect.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different weights and scales to create hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Circular red badge with white border

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and geometric feel of the main title.
Appropriate for the clean, centered track information.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a white square canvas. In the bottom center, place a rectangular grayscale photograph of a 1960s-style male vocal group. On the right side, halfway down, place a solid red circle with a thin white inner border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large 3D-extruded title in light blue at the top. Add centered black sans-serif text in the middle section for the song titles. Add white text inside the red circle.

verificationChecks: Is the title 3D and light blue?

adjustableVariables: Number of lines in track listing
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the 3D shadow on the title is consistent in direction.
Verify the red badge does not overlap the main title.
Check that the photo is a sharp rectangle with no rounded corners.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a large 3D-extruded sans-serif title at the top with a centered grayscale photo at the bottom, separated by clean, centered sans-serif informational text and a bright circular accent badge.
